    # Create the arm beam within build zone
    arm = sandbox.add_beam(
        x=arm_center_x,
        y=arm_center_y,
        width=arm_length,
        height=0.2,
        angle=arm_angle,
        density=2.0,
    )
    
    # Set material properties for the arm
    sandbox.set_material_properties(arm, restitution=0.35)
    
    # Add pivot joint to ground for the arm
    sandbox.add_joint(arm, None, (pivot_x, pivot_y), type="pivot")
    
    # Calculate rest_length for the spring between ground and tip
    rest_length = 2.0  # Compressed spring to store energy
    spring = sandbox.add_spring(
        ground,
        arm,
        (pivot_x, pivot_y),
        (tip_x, tip_y),
        rest_length=rest_length,
        stiffness=3000.0,
        damping_ratio=0.24
    )
    
    # Connect projectile to the tip of the arm with a pivot joint
    sandbox.add_joint(arm, projectile, (tip_x, tip_y), type="pivot")
    
    # Verify mass constraints
    total_mass = sandbox.get_structure_mass()
    if total_mass > sandbox.MAX_STRUCTURE_MASS:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Launcher mass {total_mass:.2f} kg exceeds the "
            f"{sandbox.MAX_STRUCTURE_MASS:.2f} kg budget"
        )
    
    return projectile

    # No active control needed - spring will naturally release
    pass
